setup_policy_mode: The guided setup is not available while the interface edits a CI policy.
setup_step_mismatch: The guided setup is at another step now (it was changed in another tab or window).
setup_step_mismatch_fix: Reload the page to see the current step.
setup_step_unreachable: That step needs the previous ones first.
setup_skip_refused: This step cannot be skipped: the next ones depend on it.
setup_component_unknown: The component {id} is not among the ones found in this project.
setup_component_unknown_fix: Reload the step to see the components found now.
setup_config_conflict: {file} changed since the step was opened.
setup_config_conflict_fix: Reload the step to see the current version before saving again.
setup_config_exists_fix: Reload the page: the guided setup then changes only the chosen profile.
setup_plan_required: Review the plan before starting the first validation.
setup_not_configured: This project has no jgates.yml yet: choose the profile in step 4 first.
